rows.text: when `ecx` is at most 3 (unsigned `ja`, so a negative `ecx` also fails) and qword `0209A1F0`[`ecx`*8] is non-null, returns the zero-extended word at offset 0 of that pointer; otherwise returns -1 (`or eax, 0xffffffff`)

sets bit 3 (0x08) of byte `+0x17` of the 0x288-byte record at `02098E10` + `ecx`*0x288 (`ecx` sign-extended) when `edx` is non-zero and clears it when `edx` is zero; then stores to byte `02099DA1`, and leaves in `eax`, 1 when bit 3 is set in any of the bytes `02098E27`, `020990AF`, `02099337`, `020995BF`, `02099847` (byte `+0x17` of records 0 to 4) and 0 otherwise
when the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` are 011 (`AND 0xe0` equals 0x60), stores `xmm1` to floats `+0xC4` and `+0xCC` of qword `rcx+0xB8`; otherwise returns without writing

switches on the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` (`shr 5`): for 1 it stores `xmm1` to float `+0x6C` of qword `rcx+0xB8`, for 3 it stores `xmm1` to float `+0xCC` of that qword, and for any other value it returns without writing

takes the absolute values a of `xmm1` and b of `xmm2` (each widened to double, masked with `01CEBD80` to clear the sign bit, and narrowed back) and switches on the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` (`shr 5`): for 1 it sets bit 1 of byte `+0x5D` of qword `rcx+0xB8`, stores a and b to floats `+0x30` and `+0x34`, and stores a to float `+0x40` and b to float `+0x44` when the float there is above it; for 3 it tail-jumps through `0026BFF0` + 0x38 with `rcx`, `xmm1` = a and `xmm2` = b; for any other value it returns

takes p = qword `+0xD8` of qword `0209AC30`, or qword `+0x100` of it when that is null, and returns when p is null; otherwise stores dword 1 at `p+0xCC` and qword 2 at `p+0xC4`, then, when `ecx` is -1, sets dword `p+0xC0` to 0xA if it is 0, and for any other `ecx` sets dword `p+0xC0` to 1 if it is 9

when qword `+0xF0` of qword `0209AC30` is non-null and `ecx` is at most 7 (unsigned), writes the 0x18-byte record at that pointer + 0xC0 + `ecx`*0x18: word `+0x10` = `dx`, word `+0x12` = `r8w`, dword `+0` = 0x200020 and dword `+4` = 0x800080; otherwise returns without writing

returns 1 when qword `+0xE8` of qword `0209AC30` is null or dword `+0xC8` of it is non-zero; otherwise returns 1 when byte `+0xC0` of it equals 1 (for non-zero `ecx`) or equals 2 (for `ecx` = 0), else 0

returns 1 when qword `+0xF0` of qword `0209AC30` is null, when `ecx` is above 7 (unsigned), or when bit 2 of dword `+0x14` of the 0x18-byte record at that pointer + 0xC0 + `ecx`*0x18 is set; otherwise returns 1 when bit 1 of that dword equals `edx` and 0 when it differs

returns without writing when `rcx` is null, qword `rcx+0xC0` is null, the dword it points at is -1, its low word is 0xFFFF, the record address qword `022C6F28` + (that word sign-extended)*0x740 is zero, or dword `+0x284` of that record is 0; otherwise sets bit 8 (0x100) of the record's dword `+0x304` when `edx` is non-zero and clears it when `edx` is zero, and sets bit 0x20000 of its dword `+0x290`

takes p = qword `rcx+0xC0` (null when `rcx` is null); when `xmm1` is above 0.0 it replaces `xmm1` with the int returned by the call at `002EC8B0` + 0x22 (`ecx` = `xmm1` truncated) converted back to float; then, when p is non-null and dword `[p]` is not -1, stores `xmm1` to float `p+0x1C`

takes p = qword `rcx+0xC0` (null when `rcx` is null); when `xmm1` is above 0.0 it replaces `xmm1` with the int returned by the call at `002EC970` + 0x22 (`ecx` = `xmm1` truncated) converted back to float; then, when p is non-null and dword `[p]` is not -1, stores `xmm1` to float `p+0x18`

returns 0 when `ecx` is above 6 (unsigned); otherwise jumps through a seven-entry table of 32-bit offsets indexed by `ecx`, whose case blocks in the body return 1, 2, 4, 8, 0x10, 0x20 and 0x40 (the table entries themselves are not decoded in the listing)
tests `r8d` and, with all argument registers unchanged, tail-jumps through `003DE9A0` + 0x3 when it is non-zero and through `003DE9A0` + 0x9 when it is zero
tests `r8d` and, with all argument registers unchanged, tail-jumps through `003DEA00` + 0x3 when it is non-zero and through `003DEA00` + 0x9 when it is zero

returns without writing when `rcx` is null, dword `rcx+0x10` is negative (signed), its low word is 0xFFFF, the record address qword `022C6F28` + (that word sign-extended)*0x740 is zero, or dword `+0x284` of that record is 0; otherwise ORs 8 into the record's dword `+0x290` and stores `xmm1`, `xmm2`, `xmm3` to its floats `+0x380`, `+0x384`, `+0x388`

with g = qword `0209AC30`, returns without writing when qword `g+0x158` is 0, q = qword `+0x138` of qword `g+0x320` is null (or the `+0x320` pointer is), or `ecx` is neither -1 nor 0; for -1 it writes four words to `rdx`: word `q+0x98` + 8, word `q+0x9A`, word `q+0x9C` - 0x48, word `q+0x9E`; for 0, with s = qword `+0x18` of qword `q+0x60`, it writes word `q+0x98` - 6 + word `s+0xC`, word `q+0x9A` - 6 + word `s+0xE`, word `s+0x10` - 6 and word `s+0x12` + 0xB to `rdx+0`, `+2`, `+4`, `+6`

reads i = dword `+0xF0` of qword `+0x160` of qword `0209AC30`, j = dword `+0x7370` + i*4 of qword `02EBF190`, and p = entry j of the qword array at `02CA96E0` (both indexes sign-extended); when p is non-null and byte `p+0x331` is 0 it stores word 0x101 at `p+0x330`, `cl` at byte `+0x336`, `dl` at byte `+0x337`, `r8w` at word `+0x33C` and 0 at byte `+0x33B`, then makes the call at `00567AE0` + 0x67 (with `ecx`, `edx`, `r8d` still the incoming values) and stores its `al` at byte `p+0x33A`; otherwise returns without writing

notes: 0035A140: the jump table's entries are not decoded in the listing; the row assumes each of the seven table entries reaches a distinct one of the seven return blocks (1, 2, 4, 8, 0x10, 0x20, 0x40 in address order), so ecx = n most likely returns 1 << n, but the per-case mapping is not stated and should be checked against the table before applying. 002D75F0: when qword +0xD8 is null the body re-reads qword +0x100 for the stores, so both the stores and the +0xC0 test always hit the same pointer p. 002E75A0/003EB860: the 'record address is zero' test is the je after the add of qword 022C6F28 (flags of the add). 0026BFF0: the 'when the float there is above it' test is comiss/jbe, so an unordered compare also skips the store. 0026A2A0: the five tested bytes are byte +0x17 of records 0 to 4 at stride 0x288 from 02098E10 (02098E10+0x17, +0x29F, +0x527, +0x7AF, +0xA37).
